# has spatial measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-hasSpatialMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSpatialMeasurement>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to a spatial measurement describing its coordinates, geometry, pose, or spatial extent. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified [`SpatialMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialMeasurement.md) when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat inverse link from an entity to a spatial measurement about it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when vantage, confidence, or standpoint matter — read the reified measurement; promote rather than flatten.

### How to use

- Use [`gmeow:hasSpatialMeasurement`](gmeow-hasSpatialMeasurement.md) (or the place-specific [`gmeow:hasCoordinateObservation`](gmeow-hasCoordinateObservation.md)) to reach the measurement carrying frame and provenance.
